summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by Onex Direct Lending BDC Fund reporting quarterly portfolio and business commentary as of March 31, 2026. The filing discloses net asset value per share of $18.75, net investment income of $0.55 per share, and dividends of $0.54 per share. It discusses portfolio composition, unrealized losses, non-accrual status, and leverage ratios. There are no events related to acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or management changes. Therefore, this filing does not qualify as a special situation.
